{{Pisces}}
Pisces 2 is the 86th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 2nd day of Pisces, and it is a Tuesday. It corresponds to ISO week 13, weekday 2.

Its informal Japanese name is 4宮2日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 86|Chapter 86]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152106}}.
